title: Tech disruption impacts worker earnings
discussion_signal: The NBER announcement translates the creative-destruction paper into a worker-risk signal: rival innovations can pass through to incumbent earnings and job destruction, with asymmetric exposure for top workers. It makes product-market rivalry a labor-income and household-security question, not only a firm-growth question.
linked_research_question: When product-market innovation displaces incumbent firms, which workers bear earnings and job risk, how quickly do they recover, and what firm, market, or policy institutions spread the gains and losses?
limits: The announcement does not disclose the full estimates or sample counts
Worker earnings and job destruction do not by themselves measure household welfare or recovery
Public discussion is not a representative worker sample
